scope: Diagnostic baseline; no optimization, promotion or speed gain

workloads.code: Write Python code for a small LRU cache with get and put methods, a capacity limit, and a demonstration. Explain its correctness and time complexity after the code. Be detailed.
workloads.prose: Explain how to design a fair computer performance experiment. Cover warmup, input sizes, background activity, repeated trials, latency, throughput and memory. Use about 700 words with concrete examples.

notes: English only. Small model validates monitoring; it cannot establish full-model helper bottlenecks.
Exact inputs/output IDs/text/finish and request topology required across every arm, including warmups.
Observer-on timings quantify monitoring perturbation; only uninstrumented controls are throughput baselines.
Four fresh owned processes; no automatic retry, partial resume, mid-run cleanup or default changes.
Long prompt and cached continuation remain separate future safety cohorts. No tensor callbacks, extra synchronization or disabled fusion.
